concerns.text: T026 (Noise Injection) is listed as a prerequisite for T016 and T023, but T026 is placed AFTER T016/T023 in the task list order. T026 must physically precede T016 and T023 in the execution sequence to ensure the noise logic is available when the loops are implemented.
T007 (Validation Helpers) depends on T004 (Schema Contracts), but T007 is listed before T004 in the task list. T004 must be completed and the schema files created before T007 can import them.
T009 (State Store) is required for T021 (CAP Classifier), but T009 is listed after T021 in the task list. T009 must precede T021 to ensure the state store utility exists for the classifier to use.

T008 (Seed Management) is required for T016, T023, and T026, but T008 is listed after T026 in the task list. T008 must precede T026 to ensure seed management is available for the noise injection logic.
T016 (Static ZPPO Loop) depends on T026 (Noise Injection), but T016 is listed before T026 in the task list. T026 must be implemented before T016 to ensure the loop can call the noise function.
T023 (CAP Loop) depends on T026 (Noise Injection) and T021 (CAP Classifier), but T023 is listed before T026 and T021 in the task list. T021 and T026 must precede T023.
T022 (Dynamic NCQ Generator) depends on T021 (CAP Classifier), but T022 is listed before T021. T021 must precede T022 to provide the classification logic.
T034 (Versioning) depends on T001 (Project Structure), but T034 is listed before T001 is marked complete in the task list. T001 must precede T034.
T004 description states 'These files are currently missing', but the task list order implies they should be created before T007. The task list order contradicts the dependency description.
T008 description states 'MUST be implemented before any simulation tasks', but the task list order places it after T026. The task list order contradicts the dependency description.
